serviceName: vvd site on your domain (Cloudflare DNS)
description: Points a bare domain and its www name at a site published on vvd. For Cloudflare DNS only: Cloudflare flattens the root CNAME and does not support APEXCNAME. vvd requests this service only when discovery returns cloudflare.com, without host. hostRequired is set only because a CNAME at @ requires it (DCTL1012); Cloudflare ignores it. Mail and other records are left alone.
